ModMetaData.name: Dyze's Pathogenics
ModMetaData.author: Dyze
ModMetaData.description:
Dyze's Pathogenics is a RimWorld mod focused on disease simulation instead of random one-off illness events.
The current v0.3 slice adds a complete standalone respiratory disease loop with hidden progression, outsider importation, player feedback, and balancing controls.
Included in this slice: - Hidden disease state before symptoms appear - Visible symptomatic disease for player feedback and testing - Proximity-based respiratory transmission with configurable spread multiplier - Outsider importation from visitors, traders, raiders, refugees, prisoners, and quest pawns - Symptom-onset notifications and debug readout tools - Settings for simulation toggles and balancing
Not included yet: - Quarantine tools - Additional disease types - World map spread
